name: agentmemory-config
title_zh: 不翻源码就改配置，环境变量端口开关全在这
tagline_zh: 改端口、设 API key、开功能开关，翻遍 README 找不到的默认关闭原因，它直接告诉你。
tagline_en: Change ports, set API keys, toggle features, and learn why defaults are off—without grepping the source.
desc_en: agentmemory configuration, environment variables, ports, and feature flags. Use when enabling a feature, changing ports, setting an API key, configuring auth, or explaining why a feature is off by default.
why_zh: 把散落在代码里的配置项、环境变量、端口和 feature flag 收拢成一张清单。
why_en: Centralizes scattered env vars, ports, and feature flags into one categorized reference—ask it instead of digging through code.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 agentmemory 这一个项目的配置面，不解释业务逻辑；改完配置不负责验证生效，也不管重启流程。
limit_en: Covers only agentmemory's config surface, not business logic. Won't verify changes take effect or handle restarts. May reference outdated names.
title_en: Change config without reading source: env vars, ports, flags
unshelf_reason: 2026-09-04 编辑判：记忆引擎的配置/接线/拆解三件，英文开发工具链（冷在读者身上）
